# case: parked-mail-only
## problems
warn fix.p.parked-mail {"name":"example.com"}
warn fix.p.parked-sends {"name":"example.com","record":"v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com ~all"}
## notes
fix.n.parked-mail {}
## check
z=example.com&r=is+@+MX+0+.%5E10+mail.example.com.&r=is+@+TXT+%22v=spf1+-all%22%5E%22v=spf1+include:spf.protection.outlook.com+~all%22&r=is+_dmarc+TXT+%22v=DMARC1;+p=reject;+rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com%22%5E%22v=DMARC1;+p=none;+rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com%22
## bind
; DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
; The records below are what the changed sets hold afterwards;
; every other record of the zone stays as it is.
$ORIGIN example.com.

; example.com MX
@ 3600 IN MX 0 .
; delete: @ 3600 IN MX 10 mail.example.com.

; example.com TXT (SPF); the other TXT records of @ stay
@ 3600 IN TXT "v=spf1 -all"
; delete: @ 3600 IN TXT "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com ~all"

; _dmarc.example.com TXT (DMARC); the other TXT records of _dmarc stay
_dmarc 3600 IN TXT "v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"
; delete: _dmarc 3600 IN TXT "v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"
## route53
{
  "Comment": "DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "example.com.",
        "Type": "MX",
        "TTL": 3600,
        "ResourceRecords": [
          {
            "Value": "0 ."
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "example.com.",
        "Type": "TXT",
        "TTL": 3600,
        "ResourceRecords": [
          {
            "Value": "\"google-site-verification=abc123\""
          },
          {
            "Value": "\"v=spf1 -all\""
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "_dmarc.example.com.",
        "Type": "TXT",
        "TTL": 3600,
        "ResourceRecords": [
          {
            "Value": "\"v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com\""
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
## cloudflare
#!/bin/sh
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# Needs an API token that may edit this zone's DNS records (Zone > DNS > Edit) and the zone ID
# (the zone's Overview page). Neither is written here: set both in your shell first.
: "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:?set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN to your API token}"
: "${CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID:?set CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID to the zone ID of example.com}"
API="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID/dns_records"

# 1. Change example.com MX: 10 mail.example.com. -> 0 .
#    Find the record's id, then:
curl -sS "$API?type=MX&name=example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X PATCH "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"MX","name":"example.com","content":".","priority":0,"ttl":3600}'

# 2. Change example.com TXT (SPF): "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com ~all" -> "v=spf1 -all"
#    Find the record's id, then:
curl -sS "$API?type=TXT&name=example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X PATCH "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"TXT","name":"example.com","content":"\"v=spf1 -all\"","ttl":3600}'

# 3. Change _dmarc.example.com TXT (DMARC): "v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com" -> "v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"
#    Find the record's id, then:
curl -sS "$API?type=TXT&name=_dmarc.example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X PATCH "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"TXT","name":"_dmarc.example.com","content":"\"v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com\"","ttl":3600}'
## cloudflare notes
fix.fn.cloudflare-ids {}
## octodns
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# In the zone's YAML (example.com.yaml): set these entries; the other names stay as they are.
---
'':
  - type: MX
    ttl: 3600
    values:
      - exchange: '.'
        preference: 0
  - type: TXT
    ttl: 3600
    values:
      - 'google-site-verification=abc123'
      - 'v=spf1 -all'
_dmarc:
  - type: TXT
    ttl: 3600
    values:
      - 'v=DMARC1\; p=reject\; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com'
## terraform-cloudflare
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# terraform-provider-cloudflare v4 (cloudflare_record; v5 names it cloudflare_dns_record).
variable "cloudflare_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The zone ID of example.com"
}

# change: the resource that holds example.com MX 10 mail.example.com. gets the value below

resource "cloudflare_record" "mx_apex" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.com"
  type     = "MX"
  content  = "."
  priority = 0
  ttl      = 3600
}

# change: the resource that holds example.com TXT "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com ~all" gets the value below

resource "cloudflare_record" "txt_apex" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.com"
  type     = "TXT"
  content  = "v=spf1 -all"
  ttl      = 3600
}

# change: the resource that holds _dmarc.example.com TXT "v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com" gets the value below

resource "cloudflare_record" "txt_dmarc" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "_dmarc.example.com"
  type     = "TXT"
  content  = "v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"
  ttl      = 3600
}
## terraform-route53
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# aws_route53_record manages a whole record set: every value of the name and type is listed.
variable "route53_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The hosted zone ID of example.com"
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "mx_apex" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "example.com"
  type    = "MX"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["0 ."]
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "txt_apex" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "example.com"
  type    = "TXT"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["google-site-verification=abc123", "v=spf1 -all"]
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "txt_dmarc" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "_dmarc.example.com"
  type    = "TXT"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"]
}
## en
DNS change request: example.com

Please make the following changes in the DNS zone example.com. Records not listed here stay as they are.

1. Replace: MX records
   Name: example.com
   Value:
     0 .
   TTL: 3600
   This removes:
     10 mail.example.com.
2. Replace: SPF record (TXT)
   Name: example.com
   Value:
     "v=spf1 -all"
   TTL: 3600
   This removes:
     "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com ~all"
   The other TXT records of the name stay as they are.
3. Replace: DMARC record (TXT)
   Name: _dmarc.example.com
   Value:
     "v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"
   TTL: 3600
   This removes:
     "v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"
   The other TXT records of the name stay as they are.

Notes:
- Only for a domain that sends and receives no mail: mail to it bounces at once and mail as it is rejected.

Once the change is made, this link shows whether public DNS resolvers see it:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+@+MX+0+.%5E10+mail.example.com.&r=is+@+TXT+%22v=spf1+-all%22%5E%22v=spf1+include:spf.protection.outlook.com+~all%22&r=is+_dmarc+TXT+%22v=DMARC1;+p=reject;+rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com%22%5E%22v=DMARC1;+p=none;+rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com%22
## tr
DNS değişiklik talebi: example.com

Lütfen example.com DNS zone’unda aşağıdaki değişiklikleri yapın. Burada yer almayan kayıtlar olduğu gibi kalır.

1. Değiştir: MX kayıtları
   Ad: example.com
   Değer:
     0 .
   TTL: 3600
   Bu değişiklikle kaldırılanlar:
     10 mail.example.com.
2. Değiştir: SPF kaydı (TXT)
   Ad: example.com
   Değer:
     "v=spf1 -all"
   TTL: 3600
   Bu değişiklikle kaldırılanlar:
     "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com ~all"
   Adın diğer TXT kayıtları olduğu gibi kalır.
3. Değiştir: DMARC kaydı (TXT)
   Ad: _dmarc.example.com
   Değer:
     "v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"
   TTL: 3600
   Bu değişiklikle kaldırılanlar:
     "v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"
   Adın diğer TXT kayıtları olduğu gibi kalır.

Notlar:
- Yalnızca e-posta almayan ve göndermeyen bir alan adı için: ona gelen e-posta hemen geri döner, onun adına gönderilen e-posta reddedilir.

Değişiklik yapıldıktan sonra genel DNS çözümleyicilerinin onu görüp görmediğini bu bağlantı gösterir:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+@+MX+0+.%5E10+mail.example.com.&r=is+@+TXT+%22v=spf1+-all%22%5E%22v=spf1+include:spf.protection.outlook.com+~all%22&r=is+_dmarc+TXT+%22v=DMARC1;+p=reject;+rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com%22%5E%22v=DMARC1;+p=none;+rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com%22
